# Dwarkesh Tour (Dwarkesh Riksha & Tour Service)

> Official website: https://dwarkadarshantour.com
> Business: Dwarkesh Tour & Riksha Service
> Founder & Lead Guide: Ashokbhai Chavda
> Primary Stand: Teen Batti Chowk, Dwarka, Devbhumi Dwarka, Gujarat 361335, India
> Contact / Direct WhatsApp Booking: +91 99981 51725 (9998151725)
> Service Area: Dwarka, Devbhumi Dwarka, Bet Dwarka, Shivrajpur Beach, Porbandar, Somnath, Gujarat

## Overview
Dwarkesh Tour is the premier local pilgrimage and sightseeing transport service based at Teen Batti Chowk, Dwarka, Gujarat. Operated with over 10+ years of local expertise by Ashokbhai Chavda, the service provides both traditional Auto Rickshaws and 4-Wheeler Cars (like Maruti Ertiga, Innova, Swift Dzire) assigned according to group size and visitor comfort.

## Services & Tour Packages

### 1. Dwarka Darshan (Complete 8 Sacred Places Tour)
- **Duration**: ~5.5 hours per shift
- **Daily Shifts**: 
  - Morning Shift: 07:30 AM to 01:00 PM
  - Afternoon / Sunset Shift: 01:30 PM to 07:00 PM
- **Vehicles Available**: Auto Rickshaw (1-4 persons) & 4-Wheeler Car / Taxi (larger families & groups)
- **Places Covered (All 8 Sacred Spots)**:
  1. Nageshwar Jyotirling (One of the 12 sacred Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva with an 80-ft statue)
  2. Gopi Talab (Sacred lake of Lord Krishna's Raas Leela & source of holy Gopi Chandan)
  3. Bet Dwarka (Island residence of Lord Krishna via Sudarshan Setu cable bridge or ferry)
  4. Rukmini Temple (2,500-year-old architectural marvel dedicated to Goddess Rukmini)
  5. Shivrajpur Beach (Internationally certified Blue Flag beach with crystal-clear turquoise waters)
  6. Bhadkeshwar Mahadev Temple (Sea cliff temple on the Arabian Sea rocks)
  7. Sunset Point (Panoramic ocean cliff sunset viewing point)
  8. Geeta Mandir (Pure white marble temple with all 18 Bhagavad Gita chapters engraved)

### 2. Somnath Darshan (Coastal Highway Pilgrimage from Dwarka)
- **Duration**: Full day coastal tour
- **Route**: Dwarka -> Miyani -> Porbandar -> Veraval -> Somnath
- **Vehicles Available**: 4-Wheeler Car / Taxi & Auto Rickshaw as per passenger count
- **Places Covered**:
  1. Harsiddhi Mata Temple (Ancient coastal Shaktipeeth at Miyani)
  2. Mul Dwarka (Historic landing spot of Lord Krishna)
  3. Sudama Temple (World's only notable temple of Sudama in Porbandar)
  4. Kirti Mandir (Mahatma Gandhi's ancestral birthplace)
  5. Bhalka Tirth (Sacred Krishna Dehotsarg place under the peepal tree)
  6. Somnath Jyotirling (First of the 12 Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva)
